metadata.Name: RusTitW
metadata.Description: A large-scale, human-labeled dataset for Russian text recognition in-the-wild. It addresses the lack of training data for Russian scene text recognition. The paper also presents a synthetic dataset and generation code, available on GitHub.
metadata.Paper Title: RusTitW: Russian Language Text Dataset for Visual Text in-the-Wild Recognition
metadata.Abstract: Information surrounds people in modern life. nText is a very efficient type of information that people use for communication for centuries. nHowever, automated text-in-the-wild recognition remains a challenging problem. nThe major limitation for a DL system is the lack of training data.nFor the competitive performance, training set must contain many samples that replicate the real-world cases.nWhile there are many high-quality datasets for English text recognition; there are no available datasets for Russian language.nIn this paper, we present a large-scale human-labeled dataset for Russian text recognition in-the-wild. nWe also publish a synthetic dataset and code to reproduce the generation process.
